facts: $\mathrm{D}^{\oplus}(f)=O(\sqrt{\mathrm{spar}(f)}\log \mathrm{spar}(f))$; whether $\mathrm{poly}\log \mathrm{spar}$ suffices is the query analogue of the log-rank conjecture.
$\deg_2(f)\le\log_2(\mathrm{spar}(f)+1)$. The real degree is not bounded by sparsity: $\oplus_n$ has $\deg = n$ and $\mathrm{spar} = 1$.
